name: Illustration · Cut-paper collage
description: Zero drawn lines. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.

instructions.image: Zero drawn lines: torn pieces with a white fibrous edge, scissor pieces crisp, each lifting a soft shadow off the piece below. A finished illustration in this one medium; never a photograph, a 3D render or a live-action frame. Use the attached reference frame for the medium, palette and line quality only, never for its subject.
instructions.motion: Slow camera drift and gentle parallax; marks settle in the way the medium is made. One focal action at a time.
instructions.composition: Keep all titles, labels, data and logos as editable HTML/SVG overlays. Use approved copy and supplied screenshots. Brand colors and fonts override reference palettes. Keep one style for the whole film.
instructions.negative: No generated text, logos, invented statistics or fake product UI. No unseeded randomness, render-time network or live clocks.
requiredAssets: One approved style key reused for every shot
The reference frame for this style
acceptance: The medium stays recognisable in hook, screenshot, success and CTA beats
Readable copy in landscape, portrait and square
Identical pixels after repeated and backward seeking
All visual marks follow the selected brand/theme
